examples.name: US-001-another-customers-order
examples.scenario:
Feature: read an order
  Rule: orders_router.INV1
    Scenario: another customer's order is not found
      Given ann has an order of 5.00
      When bob reads it
      Then the answer is 404 "Order not found"

rule_texts.orders_router.INV1: a customer only ever reads their own orders

decisions.question: Who may call each route: anyone, an authenticated user, the owner of the resource, which role?
decisions.answer: Authenticated customers (get_current_user), each only on their own orders

decisions.question: Status codes: success, not found, conflict, forbidden - and the error body format?
decisions.answer: 201 created, 200 read, 404 not found; errors as {"detail": "..."}

decisions.question: Invalid input: FastAPI's 422, or 400 with your own error format?
Lists: pagination, default and maximum page size - or no list route?
decisions.answer: No list route; POST repeated: two orders (no idempotency key yet)

decisions.question: A POST or PUT repeated by a client retry: an idempotency key, or duplicates accepted?
decisions.answer: No list route; POST repeated: two orders (no idempotency key yet)

questions.title: Personal data
questions.question: Purpose: why does it process personal data (the columns of its spec card), and for whom - e.g. to bill customers for their orders, for the finance team?
questions.answer: Take and show the orders of each customer, for that customer only

questions.title: Personal data
questions.question: Legal basis (GDPR art. 6): consent, contract, legal obligation, vital interests, public task or legitimate interests - and where is it recorded - e.g. contract, in the record of processing?
questions.answer: Contract: the customer's orders (terms of sale)

safety.question: Data exposed (a user sees or changes data that is not theirs; secrets or personal data in a response or a log): what must never happen?

hazards.description: A customer reads another customer's order

prevented_by.statement: a customer only ever reads their own orders

safety.question: Too much (unbounded results, duplicated records, a flood of requests): what must never happen?
safety.dismissed: No route returns a list; each answer is one order

safety.question: Wrong input (invalid values, out of range, an illegal state change): what must never happen?

suggestion.hazard: invalid input is accepted and saved

safety.question: Sent twice (a client retries or submits twice): what must never happen?

suggestion.hazard: a retried request is applied twice
suggestion.invariant: No list route; POST repeated: two orders (no idempotency key yet) (decision 5)

decision.answer: No list route; POST repeated: two orders (no idempotency key yet)
